symbols.name: route length
symbols.meaning: The number of edges on a route, so the route has $L+1$ vertices.
symbols.quote: Let $L$ be the number of edges on the route, and write its vertices $x_0,x_1,\dots,x_L$, with $x_0$ the source and $x_L$ the sink.

relations.quote: A logical array is an instance of an [Array](array.md) indexed by a common address set.
The logical array of a role is carried by the [Linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md) at that role.
